QuestInfo.name: Blind and Battered 4
QuestInfo.0: Kenshin mistook you for an enemy and nearly sliced your nose off. You might want to clue her in on the situation before you lose something you like.
QuestInfo.1: Kenshin has no interest in talking on the battlefield. It's a place of battle after all. Maybe you can satisfy her thirst for combat so she'll talk to you.\r\nGo back to the original plan and defeat the superior Oda Scout to gain her respect.
QuestInfo.2: After showing your worth in battle, Kenshin finally settled down to talk to you, but she kept reminding you that there were enemies to slay. Maybe she's onto something.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# Can proceed to the Echigo's Dragon quest

default.0: I thought you'd be ready for at least 50 scouts by now. Perhaps not?
